structure.label: Bullish structure
structure.explanation: Price is above SMA20/SMA50 and positioned near a recent or 52-week high.

participation.label: Participation contracting
participation.explanation: Multiple trading-activity measures are below their recent baseline.

flow.label: Foreign flow neutral
flow.explanation: Foreign activity does not provide a decisive contextual signal.

liquidity.label: Healthy liquidity
liquidity.explanation: Trading value, frequency, volume, and available history meet the minimum execution-quality baseline.
